description: 打开 Ant Design Select 下拉框（模拟 mousedown 以触发 ant 内部逻辑）。支持 scopeSelector 限定作用域。

steps.expression: (() => { const scope = document.querySelector('{{scopeSelector}}'); if (!scope) return { ok: false, error: 'scope_not_found', scope: '{{scopeSelector}}' }; const currentValue = (scope.querySelector('.ant-select-selection-item')?.textContent || '').trim(); const selector = scope.querySelector('.ant-select-selector') || scope; selector.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: window })); return { ok: true, currentValue, scope: '{{scopeSelector}}' }; })()
